source_evaluation.coverage: global crawl; live-feed domains present but at far below RSS volume (MEASURED: ~15 coindesk and ~16 cointelegraph items/day over first 85 days)
source_evaluation.timestamps: ingest time per row (V2.1DATE, never early) + publisher time for ~40-45% of rows (MEASURED 992/2235 in one file)
source_evaluation.limitation: title only, no summary/body: the veto thresholds (sentiment<-0.6 AND impact>0.7 on one item) are unreachable on titles (MEASURED: 0 of 87,305 relevant sampled items; 4 had sentiment<-0.6, none impact>0.7)

source_evaluation.reason: rolling ~3 month window (documented behaviour; not re-tested here)
historical depth is plan-gated/paid (documented; not tested here)

source_evaluation.reason: expected sparse and with unverifiable capture-vs-publication timing

fetch_manifest.availability_rule: available_at = GDELT ingest time (V2.1DATE); replay requires available_at < signal_ts
fetch_manifest.note: gaps (missing/error files) are listed in _ledger.jsonl; absence of items in a window with a gap is NOT evidence of no news

data_location: off-repo (session scratch /tmp/gd/corpus, 519 MB filtered JSONL; not committed)

replay_slice.status: BUILT (session scratch only, NOT on the trainer, not retained after this session)
replay_slice.coverage: 2023-10-01..2026-10-12, 106,297 files (some GKG files missing upstream; see ledger)
replay_slice.filters: title-bearing rows only; domain allow-list (live feeds + BROAD_DOMAINS); title must contain one of 130 relevance keywords
replay_slice.NOT_fit_for: standalone-edge research: keyword/domain filtered, no tone/themes/entities, titles only

archive.status: CODE READY, CORPUS NOT BUILT (needs the trainer: ~40 MB/day gz = ~44 GB for 3y, ~3 files/s on 4 cores here = ~10 h; this session cannot write to the trainer)
archive.layout: <root>/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz (UTC AVAILABILITY day = day of 'a'); _ledger.jsonl per 15-min file: ok|missing|error:<msg>

fields.a: availability = GDELT ingest time (ISO Z) -- the ONLY time a backtest may gate on
fields.p: publish time = min(precise publisher ts, a); freshness only
fields.ti: headline (PAGE_TITLE; no summary/body exists in GKG)

archive.leakage_guarantee: a >= true publication time by construction (GDELT cannot ingest before publication); p <= a is enforced and tested (tests/test_news_hist_replay.py::test_archive_row_schema_and_leakage_guarantee). A signal at t may use a record iff a < t strictly. Files missing/errored in the ledger are GAPS, never 'no news'.
archive.index: per-day shards are the date index; no entity index is built yet -- build one from the shards (th/pe/or/cc) after the archive lands
archive.known_limits: headline only (no body); GKG is a crawler subset, recall of any one outlet is far below its RSS volume; ~40-45% of rows carry a publisher timestamp, the rest are dated by ingest (late, never early); 15-min files occasionally missing upstream
